{{Top|leg}}
The '''Metellos Ring''' was a celestial body that was presumably located within the [[Metellos system/Legends|Metellos system]]. [[Negastrike platoon]], a unit within the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], had conducted operations on this location alongside those of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and [[Lasan/Legends|Lasan]] prior to the [[Battle on Doshan]].
